claims.text: The shareholder proposal regarding a congruency report on net-zero emissions policies was defeated at PepsiCo's 2023 Annual Meeting held May 3, 2023.
Votes cast For the net-zero congruency report proposal were 19,718,780.
Votes cast Against the net-zero congruency report proposal were 977,228,788.
Abstentions on the net-zero congruency report proposal were 23,200,321.
